GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Rolled fwd before raced 3rd Two Wide (3L from lead) early . Out 3 Wide midrace & held together Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & faded in last 200m. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 900m had to be steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. ran on strongly when clear # had the run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped horse.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m 1st Outside Leader .5 Lengths home turn leader .5 Lengths Middle Of Track Straight tired final 200m # led/tired late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. got up fence turn 3 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly from the 1000m. When questioned, rider explained that his mount hung out from the 1000m, including rounding the home turn and in the straight and inside the final 100m when awkwardly placed inside the heels of rnr and given his mount’s racing manners and also that he was out of contention for a placing, he desisted from riding his mount out for the remainder of the race. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. 3rd turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with runner at the start. Raced keenly through the early stages and approaching the 1000m had to be severely checked after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked early to find lead. led turn. battled away # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over the concluding stages, when weakening, had to be eased when crowded between rnrs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 3 lengths. gone turn. dropped right out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping by rnr which was taken out. When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider advised that her mount travelled well in the early stages however then struggled through the much softer part of the track after the 800m and did not respond to her riding thereafter and was most disappointing. A post-race vet exam of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
